_README: SAMPLE OUTPUT — reference only. This is a genuine, unedited example of what tools/update-lottery.mjs writes to data/lottery.json after a successful fetch from the official operator feed (captured from `node tools/update-lottery.mjs --dry-run`). The live site fetches data/lottery.json, NOT this file, so nothing here is ever shown to customers. It exists to document the exact shape a verified run produces. The `_gateSydneyDate` key is the once-per-Sydney-day gate the script stamps on the file it writes; it is not part of the render contract and js/lottery.js ignores it.
jackpot: Next Saturday Lotto draw Sat, 1 Aug: $10 Million
